reviewer: AI assistant, technical visual inspection; no radiologist review

observations: All 20 original/model-input pairs inspected at contact-sheet scale.
No visible full-image boundary exclusion, blank output, or gross grayscale inversion in these pairs.
Model inputs consistently present the chest wall on the left in these examples.
Sample 11 now retains the visible breast; the original fixed window was largely background.
Substantial background and small breast areas remain in some acquisitions, including samples 5 and 16.
limitations: This is an engineering review of 20 images, not diagnostic or lesion-preservation validation.
Downscaling ranged from 0.3906408952187182 to 1; fine features can be lost.
Orientation is a heuristic; success on these examples does not validate the entire cohort.
No cancer predictions were judged and no RSNA cohort accuracy was used to select the repair.
